within_group.note: 'pooled_within_*' centres DG and R@1 inside each group and then correlates the stacked deviations: the pure within-group slope. Compare with the pooled r over all 204 rows.

cluster_robust_OLS.note: CR1 = G/(G-1)*(n-1)/(n-k) finite-sample correction; p from t with G-1 df, the conventional conservative choice for few clusters.

self_test_reml.caveat: component-wise recovery is weakest for the factor with fewest levels; use the ICCs as order-of-magnitude, not exact
